purpose: Show that ordinal mismatch classes do not collapse into ordinary metric values.

counterexample_case.label: Ordinal class without scalar interpretation
counterexample_case.setup: Two distinct A|E comparisons both receive LOW_MISMATCH under declared <S> yet differ in residue history and orientation context.
counterexample_case.result: The shared ordinal class does not determine any unique numeric distance, unit, or norm.

misreadings_blocked: LOW_MISMATCH is not a numeric value.
HIGH_MISMATCH is not a unit-bearing quantity.
ADMISSIBILITY_BREAK is not a metric maximum.
No class here implies a Euclidean space.
forbidden_inference: Ordinal class does not imply numeric distance.
Ordinal class does not imply physical measurement.
Ordinal class does not imply topology.
Ordinal class does not imply role symmetry.
Ordinal class does not modify RT_core.

non_claims: Does not prove impossibility of all metrics.
